0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Iala Jul has a request for a child of man.

24.original: Defeat either a rabbit's tail, a tot aevis, or a phooka.

48.original: Well, that a child of man should appear at this moment! This little one is fortunate indeed.

49.original: I have the honor of watching over the life forming within this egg. It will be a happy day when it finally comes out into the world. Alas, it is not like to grow up knowing men, and that thought saddens me.

50.original: But I have an idea. If you can spare the time, will you not bring me something warm with which to line yonder nest?

51.original: The fleece of a rabbit's tail, the feathers of a tot aevis, or the pelt of a phooka─any one of these shall serve.

52.original: Please, bring me either the fleece of a rabbit's tail, the feathers of a tot aevis, or the pelt of a phooka. I will use it to line yonder nest.

53.original: Welcome back. So, what did you bring?

54.original: Ah, the fleece of a rabbit's tail. While it is no secret whence it derives its name, the creature is shrouded in mystery thick as its fleece.

55.original: Ah, the feathers of a tot aevis. While the creature's appearance cannot be said to be pleasant, its feathers provide unrivaled warmth.

56.original: Ah, the pelt of a phooka. You have done well to obtain this. When I gaze into the creature's eyes, I feel as though I am gazing into madness.

57.original: Thank you, this shall make an excellent lining for the nest. And when the little one is born, I will be certain to tell it the tale of your visit and your gift.

58.original: It will bring it great joy to have a connection to a child of man, this I know. Please accept this by way of gratitude.
